'''Robeir XXIII''' was the head of the [[House of Cron]] and the ruler of the [[Cronese Mandate/Legends|Cronese Mandate]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He paid court to [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and ruled as a client [[King of Cron|king]]. Robeir preserved a certain level of independence to the sector and a fairly large [[Navy/Legends|defense fleet]], but was overseen by Imperial troops.
